quests.title: Warp and Weft
quests.summary: Gather dyes from the hills so Úna can weave a bolt of Donegal tweed.

steps.text: Get crotal lichen from the lichen gatherer near Errigal, in Glenveagh.
Ask Nóra the weaver in Gaoth Dobhair for heather and whin dyes.
Take the dyes back to Úna at the Tweed House in Donegal Town.
See off the fashion buyer who wants the bolt before it's woven.

quests.reward: A Donegal Tweed Cap (a charm against gale moves) and standing in Ireland.

quests.title: Top of Donegal
quests.summary: Climb Errigal, the highest mountain in Donegal, and race the fell runner at the top.

steps.text: Follow the path round and up to the summit of Errigal.
Beat Ciarán the fell runner on the summit.

quests.reward: A chip of Errigal Quartz (a charm for stone moves) and standing in Ireland.

quests.title: A King for Tory
quests.summary: Tory Island needs a new king. Help the islanders choose one, and find a band for the crowning.

steps.text: Take the boat from Bunbeg to Tory and talk to Séamus on the pier.
Ask the gallery keeper on Tory who the island wants.
Find a céilí band: the fiddler in the pub in Gaoth Dobhair and the box player on the quay in Donegal Town.
See off the mainland pretender by the round tower on Tory.

quests.reward: Tory Clay (a charm against urban moves), smoked mackerel and standing in Ireland.

quests.title: The Evil Eye
quests.summary: The storyteller says Balor of the Evil Eye still sleeps at the fort on Tory's east cliffs.

steps.text: Once Tory has its king, go to Balor's Fort at the east end of the island.
Catch Balor of the Evil Eye.

quests.reward: Barmbrack for luck, standing in Ireland, and a Fomorian king in your Fieldbook.
